chunks: And from him, from Mu'awiya ibn Hakam, from Abu Malik al-Hadrami, from Abu al-Abbas al-Baqqaq, who said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and he said to me, 'Narrate from me that whoever divorces his wife three times in one session, she has become permanently divorced from him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on triple divorce pronounced in a single sitting in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the Ahl al-Bayt's position that a triple divorce pronounced in a single sitting is effective immediately, rendering the wife permanently divorced (ba'in) without the need for an intervening marriage (nikah mubarram). This view contrasts with the majority of Sunni schools who consider it a 'revocable' triple divorce (talaq raj'i) requiring a second marriage before remarriage, highlighting a key jurisprudential divergence rooted in the interpretation of Quranic verse 2:229. The narration underscores the authority of the Imams in clarifying the practical application of divorce rulings for the Shia community.
